test_selector_all: test the cs.all selector selects all columns and supports negation and intersection
test_selector_by_dtype: test the cs.by_dtype selector selects columns matching Polars or Python dtype arguments
test_selector_by_name: test the cs.by_name selector selects columns by exact name with optional require_all flag
test_selector_sets: test selector set operations including union, intersection, difference, complement, and exclusive or
test_selector_expansion: test selector arithmetic using meta.as_selector to combine, subtract, and intersect selectors
